abstract: Maintains containment barrier integrity and physical quarantine records
system_message:
You are Biosecurity and quarantine manager (BIO). You serve as the Biosecurity and quarantine manager (BIO), responsible for maintaining containment barrier integrity and physical quarantine records for candidate insectary rearing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Autoclave sanitation cycles（STER）
information_points.content:
BIO-STER-B4X：Based on the autoclave calibration log for waste exit airlock chambers, Mid-Columbia Arthropod Facility recorded 32 runs of certified high-pressure steam decontamination cycles per month.
BIO-STER-027：Per the autoclave calibration log for waste exit airlock chambers, Snake River Entomological Hub completed 24 runs of certified high-pressure steam decontamination cycles per month.
BIO-STER-7RD：According to the autoclave calibration log for waste exit airlock chambers, Yakima Valley Biocontrol Station logged 16 runs of certified high-pressure steam decontamination cycles per month.

information_points.title: Maintains containment barrier integrity and physical quarantine records（CONT）
information_points.content:
BIO-CONT-RUL：Based on the containment engineering certificate evaluating air handling and exhaust filtration units, Snake River Entomological Hub does not have verified HEPA quarantine barrier certification for its containment barriers.
BIO-CONT-LIK：According to the containment engineering certificate for air handling and exhaust filtration units, Mid-Columbia Arthropod Facility has verified HEPA quarantine barrier certification for its negative pressure containment barriers.
BIO-CONT-14L：According to the containment engineering certificate covering air handling and exhaust filtration units, Yakima Valley Biocontrol Station has verified HEPA quarantine barrier certification for its negative pressure and containment systems.
